headline.purpose: Brand logo title and section titles.

body.purpose: General UI controls, table rows, and labels.

mono.purpose: Flight numbers, tail numbers, gate IDs, UTC timers.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: High-contrast action button used for critical operations like Flight Pushback.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #fafafa; color: #09090b; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost/secondary surface button for utility triggers.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #121215; color: #fafafa; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.65rem; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); }

components.name: Occupied Gate Badge
components.description: Status badge indicating occupied gate or severe flight condition.
components.css: .ds-badge-occupied { background: rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.12); color: #fb7185; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem; border-radius: 9999px; text-transform: uppercase; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; } .ds-dot-occupied { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #f43f5e; }

components.name: Completed Task Chip
components.description: Interactive chip showing completed turnaround task state.
components.css: .ds-task-chip { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15); color: #34d399; font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.6rem; border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3); border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; }

narrative.overview: AeroSync is an obsidian dark operational control center engineered for airport ramp managers and ground turnaround crew. Inspired by high-density developer platforms (Shadcn UI aesthetic) and modern flight telemetry systems, the visual world prioritizes dark high-contrast legibility, zero decorative bloat, and rapid scannability under time-critical operational pressure.

rules.name: The Rarity Accent Rule
rules.body: Bright accent colors are reserved exclusively for active status feedback. Never use saturated colors for decorative backgrounds.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: AeroSync surfaces are flat at rest. Depth is established through 1px border lines (rgba(255,255,255,0.09)). Shadows appear only on floating overlays.

dos: Do use JetBrains Mono for all flight tail numbers, gate codes, and operational timestamps.
Do explicitly style <option> elements inside <select> dropdowns with background-color: #18181b and color: #fafafa.
Do disable the Push Back action button until all 4 turnaround tasks are marked completed.
donts: Don't use decorative grid-line background gradients or synthetic patterns.
Don't stack multiple full-width visual cards vertically when they can be grouped into the tabbed Operations Viewport.
Don't use generic default sans-serif fonts; stick to the specified Outfit + JetBrains Mono pairing.
